seriesName: Nebius on-demand GPU hourly rental price after October 1, 2026 increase
notes: All four points come from the same KuCoin article on Nebius's October 1, 2026 on-demand GPU price increase. Values shown are the new (post-increase) hourly prices; each label notes the prior price the article quotes for context, but only the new price is carried as the bare numeric value per rule 9. The old-price figures ($3.85, $4.50, $7.15, $7.85) are not separately plotted as points to avoid duplicating a currency-in-label issue -- they appear only in the label text, not as a value field.
